item.title: The Web Can't Afford a JavaScript Runtime Monoculture
item.description: Earlier this month Deno announced its whole team is joining Cloudflare. In the announcement, Ryan Dahl, who created Node.js and started Deno in 2018, also explains that development of the Deno runtime will stop after one year. (2 sources: lobsters, nodeweekly)

item.title: working on getting Deno into a foundation
item.description: The state of Deno after the Cloudflare announcement Last week we announced that the Deno company is joining Cloudflare (Deno blog post, Cloudflare blog post). This issue explains where the Deno runtime stands right now, and we'll keep it... (2 sources: javascriptweekly, nodeweekly)
